info.title: OSPFv3_AF_Router
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

admin_router_id.description: The router identifier configured for the OSPFv3 address-family instance. The router ID MUST be unique within the entire Autonomous System. If admin_router_id is present, the same will be elected as active_router_id for each AF. The router ID is in IPv4 address format. This is a global configuration and gets applied to all supported AFs. If not set, protocol chooses a router-id for each address-family.

af4_unicast_routers.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
Reference to an OSPFv3 Ipv4 Unicast Router instance that corresponds to the configured process-id.

af6_unicast_routers.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
Reference to an OSPFv3 Ipv6 Unicast Router instance which corresponds to the configured process-id.

auto_cost_ref_bw.description: The reference bandwidth, Mbits/second, for interface cost calculations. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

gr_ignore_lost_interface.description: Specifies whether to ignore OSPF interfaces that have gone down just prior to the restart event. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

helper_disable.description: Indicates whether OSPF will help a neighbor undergoing hitless restart on this interface. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

instance_tag.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_AF_Router](#/OSPFv3_AF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv3 Router instances for IPv4 & IPv6 Unicast Address Family.

lsa_arrival.description: Minimum wait time in milliseconds before same LSAs received from a peer are processed. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

hold_time.description: The base value of hold_time in milliseconds until when a next instance of same LSA generation will be delayed. This will double each time the same LSA needs to be generated till it reaches the max_wait_time after which it will start with the base time again. When set to 0, the minimum time between same LSA regeneration is not increased. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum time until when next instance of same LSA generation will be delayed. When set to 0, the maximum time between same LSA regeneration is not increased. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

start_time.description: The initial wait time in milliseconds after which LSAs will be generated. When set to 0, the LSAs are generated without any delay. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

protocol_disable.description: Disable this OSPF instance. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

restart_interval.description: If OSPF is attempting to undergo a graceful restart, this field specifies the length of grace period that should be requested from adjacent routers in grace LSAs. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

hold_time.description: Exponential backoff time in milliseconds before the next SPF calculation can be scheduled. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum duration of exponential backoff time in milliseconds until when an SPF calculation can be delayed. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

start_time.description: Initial delay in milliseconds after which an SPF calculation will be triggered. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

strict_lsa_check_disable.description: Specifies whether strict LSA checking is disabled for this OSPF router instance. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

admin_set.description: This determines whether the stub router router_lsa advertisement is set administratively. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

include_stub.description: This determines whether the router should advertise maximum metric for stub links in router_lsa. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

startup.description: This determines whether the router should advertise stub router router_lsa on start-up. The delay, in seconds, is the duration for how long, after the reboot, stub router router_lsa should be advertised. This configuration is applied to all AFs.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
